scope: Fit windowed desktop Adventure frame and battle to available laptop viewport; native fullscreen and mobile preserved.

implementation.toolbar: Measured actual height via ResizeObserver, including changed or wrapped toolbar
implementation.resizeScheduling: Coalesced on-demand requestAnimationFrame; cancelled on destroy; no permanent loop or CSS transform
implementation.battle: Inset below measured toolbar, bounded to actual frame

validation.browserWarningCorrected: WebKit ResizeObserver delivery warning during synthetic 110px toolbar resize fixed by deferring/coalescing geometry writes; final Chromium and WebKit runs contain no page errors.

limits: Headless Chromium and WebKit on Linux, no physical laptop or iPhone tested.
Window dimensions approximate laptop scaling and browser chrome; screen diagonal alone does not determine CSS viewport.
